summary: T16 client-property preservation is correctly implemented: allowlisted metadata (categories, URL, TRANSP, alarms, X-properties) is stored in a dedicated table, survives unrelated edits, explicit removals persist, scheduling/unsupported components are rejected, and ETags are deterministic.
important_context: Client properties are stored in caldav_event_properties keyed by event_id with ON DELETE CASCADE
The incoming PUT body is the source of truth: absent properties are removed (full-replacement semantics)
ALLOWED_X_PROPERTIES is limited to X-APPLE-CEVENT-CATEGORY, X-APPLE-STRUCTURED-LOCATION, X-APPLE-FALLBACK-ALARM-UID
Only DISPLAY and AUDIO alarms with a TRIGGER are preserved
